subject: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO / KMS / logging) and next steps
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 18:11:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO / KMS / logging) and next steps

Hi Sandeep — great to meet earlier today, appreciate the time and the demo of the intake flow. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Key items we heard that will determine hosting path (hosted vs dedicated vs private):
- Identity: you need company-wide SSO (SAML / Okta) with automated user provisioning (SCIM) and role mapping.
- Key management: must support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) — requirement to rotate/bring-your-own KMS.
- Logging / retention: security/audit requires retaining request/response audit logs for 7+ years and the ability to export to your archived logging storage.
- Network: preference for private networking (VPC peering / private link) for PHI-sensitive traffic; if private on-prem is not feasible, dedicated capacity with strict VPC-only access is acceptable.

Where we propose starting:
1) I'll send our security packet (SOC2, pen test summary) + a one-pager outlining Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private differences for your infra team.
2) Tech deep-dive with one of our infra engineers to review your network diagram and KMS integration model (schedule next week?).
3) Procurement: if this looks like Dedicated/Private, we can provide an initial pricing sketch and a mutual action plan.

Attachments: deployment_options_onepager.pdf, hearthwell_network_diagram_v1.pdf (from your team)

Action items (from us):
- Ava: send security artifacts + options one-pager (attached).
- Ben: join the tech deep-dive to talk SLAs and capacity sizing.
- Sandeep / Marta: share a network diagram and your procurement contact.

Thanks again — available for a short sync Thursday afternoon.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@hearthwell.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@hearthwell.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO / KMS / logging) and next steps

Thanks, Ava — good summary. A few clarifications from our security team so you know which path we'll likely pursue:

- SSO: Okta SAML required, SCIM optional but preferred. Need SP-initiated SAML and ability to map Okta groups to roles in your platform.
- KMS: We must be able to supply our own KMS (AWS KMS with custom key policy) or an HSM-backed key. If Hosted requires Redwood-managed keys only, that will push us toward Dedicated or Private.
- Audit logs: retention of 7 years is mandatory for certain data types. We need a mechanism to stream logs to our archival S3 bucket (encrypted) and to redact PII on-demand.
- Data residency: all inference logs must remain in us-east-1 unless routed to our archive.

Procurement: please include Marta (marta.lopez@hearthwell.com) — she'll lead SOW/contract and procurement. I'll also attach the network diagram and an initial security questionnaire separately by EOD.

If Redwood can support BYOK KMS + Okta SAML + log export to our S3, Dedicated might suffice; if not, we need to explore Private VPC or on-prem.

Sandeep
Director, Data Security | Hearthwell Health
sandeep.rao@hearthwell.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO / KMS / logging) and next steps

Thanks for the detail, Sandeep — that's exactly the level we need. Quick responses inline and next steps: 

- Okta SAML + SCIM: supported across all deployment modes. We'll send our SAML metadata and SCIM endpoints; mapping rules can be configured in the Console or via API.
- BYOK/HSM: Redwood Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) with CMAK patterns; Private (VPC/on-prem) supports direct HSM integration. Hosted API currently supports envelope encryption but uses Redwood-managed keys (not acceptable here).
- Logs / retention: We can stream structured audit logs to your S3 with server-side encryption, and we offer configurable retention + on-demand redaction hooks. For 7-year archival we recommend exporting to your archival S3 (we can automate monthly exports).
- Network: For PHI workloads, our recommended paths (in order): Private VPC (best) -> Dedicated with VPC peering & strict SGs -> Hosted (not recommended for PHI unless you accept managed keys).

Attachments: deployment_options_onepager.pdf (attached). I've also included an action checklist at the bottom.

Proposed technical next step: 60-minute infra deep-dive with our infra engineer (Laura) and Ben to cover KMS flow, network architecture, and logging/export. Laura, Ben — can you do Thursday 10:00am ET or Friday 2:00pm ET?

Action items (updated):
- Ava: send SOC2 summary and pen test executive brief (by EOD).
- Laura & Ben: join tech deep-dive and prepare sample network diagram integration notes.
- Sandeep / Marta: share procurement contact and any initial redlines.

We can also prepare a short Dedicated vs Private pricing sketch based on expected throughput if you want that ahead of the tech call.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Ava
